titles.english: Urusei Yatsura: The Obstacle Course Swim Meet
titles.native: うる星やつら ザ・障害物水泳大会

description:
The story is from manga volume 23.

On a very hot summer day in Tomobiki town, Lum, Ataru, and the rest of the gang are looking forward to using the school's pool. But the teachers have other plans: setting a ludicrous obstacle course between the students in their swimsuits and the pool... naturally this ends in complete chaos.
